title: perf(alerting): drain deliveries beside the alert_checks ingest, bound each insert

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge The fiber rework is sound and pinned by a real-service test; the remaining issue is the outbound-slot budget the drain shares with four ingest POSTs. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk high −1 · 1/1 new units observable Forking `ingestAlertChecks` beside the delivery drain and cutting each alert_checks POST at 5 s is sound, and the new test pins it. The four ingest POSTs take connection slots the drain needs, so a page can still queue behind a stall. None of the open alerting errors in `scheduled.ts` (PlanetScaleForbidden, WarehouseAuth, WarehouseConfig, WarehouseQuery, ChatOutbound, AlertDelivery) is addressed by this diff. - `ingestAlertChecks` runs on its own fiber, joined after the delivery drain - Each per-org POST is cut at 5 s; rows are dropped, logged and counted - `runSchedulerTick` returns `alertChecksDroppedCount`, logged per tick ### Before merge - [ ] **Manual** · Add a chart or alert on `alerting.alert_checks_dropped_total`, so check history lost to a warehouse stall is noticed ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Four concurrent alert_checks POSTs leave the drain two of the three slots it uses performance · [`packages/backend/src/services/alerts/AlertsService.ts:344-346`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/a5757d4c948cbf4620bcaa6ccee3d2741d261e3b/packages/backend/src/services/alerts/AlertsService.ts#L344-L346) The drain sends up to `DELIVERY_DESTINATION_CONCURRENCY` (3) deliveries at once and each holds an outbound connection (`AlertsService.ts:490` also notes the Postgres pool draws on them), so the four ingest POSTs the comment budgets for plus the drain ask for seven of the invocation's six slots. During a warehouse stall every ingest POST holds its connection for the full 5 s cap, so a page still waits for a slot and the PR's 41 ms figure holds only for the single-stalled-org case. Lower `ALERT_CHECK_INGEST_CONCURRENCY` while the drain overlaps it, or start the drain before the ingest is forked. ``` Set `ALERT_CHECK_INGEST_CONCURRENCY` to 3 (or 2) and fix the comment, since the drain needs three slots at once now that it overlaps. ```
